blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into the Constitution only once through the 42nd Amendment.
The Right to Education represents the most frequently asked amendment-based question in railway examinations.
The 42nd Amendment holds the record for adding the highest number of constitutional changes.
